note: MyDesk Simulation provides a tested independent 2D plane-stress CST workflow for linear static and undamped modal analysis. This is a functional solver subset, not complete Autodesk Nastran or Simulation Mechanical parity.

capabilities.name: Linear elastic isotropic material definitions
capabilities.reference_behavior: Define linear elastic isotropic materials with Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, density, and yield strength.
capabilities.expected_input: Young's modulus E, Poisson's ratio nu, yield strength
capabilities.expected_output: Validated material definition in simulation project
capabilities.differences: Validated per-project isotropic properties are implemented; no searchable vendor library, temperature curves, orthotropy, or nonlinear constitutive data.

capabilities.name: FEA node and constant strain triangle (CST) mesh definition
capabilities.reference_behavior: Construct 2D planar finite element meshes with nodes, degrees of freedom, and element thickness.
capabilities.differences: Direct node/CST construction and element validation are tested; no automatic mesh generation, refinement, quality optimization, or 3D topology.

capabilities.name: Linear static FEM equilibrium equation solver
capabilities.reference_behavior: Assemble global stiffness matrix K, apply Dirichlet boundary constraints, and solve K*u = F for nodal displacements.
capabilities.expected_input: Constrained boundary nodes and applied point loads
capabilities.expected_output: Converged global displacement vector for a constrained small model
capabilities.performance: Dense direct solver intended for small models
capabilities.differences: Small CST benchmarks verify convergence, load direction, constraints, and stress recovery. The dense penalty-based static solver is not a sparse production Nastran solver.

capabilities.name: Strain recovery and Von Mises equivalent stress evaluation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Recover element Cauchy stresses (sigma_xx, sigma_yy, tau_xy) and compute equivalent Von Mises scalar stress.
capabilities.expected_output: Element strain, stress tensor, and Von Mises scalar
capabilities.differences: Plane-stress recovery and a positive Von Mises result are regression-tested; no nodal averaging, contour rendering, principal-stress UI, or 3D stress tensor.

capabilities.name: Von Mises yield threshold detection
capabilities.reference_behavior: Compare Von Mises equivalent stress against material yield strength and identify elements at or above yield.
capabilities.expected_input: Element stress and material yield limit
capabilities.performance: Linear pass over recovered element stresses
capabilities.differences: Boolean yield threshold detection is tested; numerical factor-of-safety fields and additional failure criteria are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Engineering analysis report generation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Export structural calculation summaries including convergence state, max displacement, and peak stress.
capabilities.differences: Plain-text static and modal reports are implemented; formatted PDF/HTML reports and graphical plots are not.

capabilities.name: Undamped normal-mode analysis
capabilities.reference_behavior: Assemble stiffness and mass matrices, enforce displacement constraints, and solve the generalized eigenproblem for natural frequencies and mode shapes.
capabilities.expected_input: CST mesh, elastic modulus, density, thickness, and displacement constraints
capabilities.expected_output: Ordered natural frequencies, mass-normalized mode shapes, and eigenpair residuals
capabilities.performance: Dense symmetric eigensolver intended for small models
capabilities.differences: Closed-form two-DOF CST frequencies and residuals are verified. Limited to undamped 2D CST modes; no Lanczos extraction, damping, prestress, frequency response, or 3D elements.

capabilities.name: Versioned native project persistence and model undo/redo
capabilities.reference_behavior: Persist a simulation model and support reversible model editing in the application workflow.
capabilities.expected_input: Materials, nodes, CST elements, displacement constraints, and nodal loads
capabilities.expected_output: Validated schema-v2 project round-trip with reversible transactions
capabilities.performance: Whole-document snapshots and JSON files intended for small models
capabilities.differences: Schema-v2 round-trip, malformed-version rejection, temporary-file validation, backup creation, undo, redo, and rollback are tested. Solver results and undo history are intentionally not persisted; no Nastran deck interoperability.
